summary: Sandbach United stormed into the Edward Case Cup Quarter Finals with an emphatic 7-1 victory away at New Mills, with goals from Matty Birchall, Mason Wilson and others securing a commanding performance. The Bach will now face Alsager away in the next round on Saturday 30 January. It was a dominant display that showcased some delightful football, including an audacious chip and a slick team move for the seventh goal.
